findings.evidence: grep finds @[expose] on both definitions; perfectionPresheaf_obj, perfectionPresheaf_map, and toPerfectionPresheaf_app already characterize their computational fields using := (rfl).
findings.fix: Remove @[expose] at lines 195 and 223; use the existing projection lemmas in consumers.
findings.issue: Both perfectionPresheaf and toPerfectionPresheaf expose their bodies despite already providing characteristic projection lemmas, coupling consumers to their implementation.

findings.evidence: The declaration states TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover (fun U : X.AffineZariskiSite ↦ U.toOpens); its proof uses only iSup_affineOpens_eq_top and membership in suprema, with no perfection dependency.
findings.fix: Relocate and export this lemma in the affine Zariski site infrastructure.
findings.issue: isOpenCover_affineZariskiSite is general scheme infrastructure hidden as private in the perfection construction, preventing reuse by other affine-site gluing arguments.

summary: The API unnecessarily exposes presheaf implementation bodies and hides a reusable affine-site covering lemma.
